items.title: Retail Grocery in Canada: Our 3-Year Review
items.author: Competition Bureau Canada
items.content:
<article>Food affordability remains a major concern for Canadians. While many global and economic factors affect food prices, competition plays an important role in keeping prices in check and supporting choice and innovation.

In this video, the Competition Bureau highlights the steps governments across Canada have taken since the publication of our 2023 retail grocery market study report. While progress has been made, we continue to encourage governments across Canada to implement the recommendations of our report.

Learn more about the follow-up and our recommendations: 

https://competition-bureau.canada.ca/en/how-we-foster-competition/education-and-outreach/publications/assessing-progress-competition-bureaus-retail-grocery-recommendations?utm_campaign=cb-bc-social-media-26-27&utm_medium=smo&utm_source=yt&utm_content=grocery-en-260903</article>

items.title: Canada needs more competition
items.author: Competition Bureau Canada
items.content:
<article>Canada needs more competition

Could Canada benefit from greater competition? Based on what evidence? What would need to change? Is that what Canadians want? We’ll hear from a senior policy advisor on how competition issues resonate with Canadians based on polling and market research.
Matthew Chiasson, Senior Policy Advisor, Competition Bureau Canada</article>
